candidates.note: Rechecked 19 Sep 2026. The actual PistonHeads advert and Bedford Cars current inventory both show WX05 EFZ live at £44,995, 23,000 miles and manual. Exact-registration evidence also matches the prior UK-delivered six-speed-manual car and May 2026 MOT. However PistonHeads explicitly states 2 previous owners; the current repo rule requires total owners including the current keeper, so this implies at least 3 total owners and fails the maximum-2-total-owner cap. First five current listing photos showed no unavailable overlay, but the owner-count failure is decisive. Reject and do not publish.
